name: Lucas County, Ohio (United States)
description: Navy blue field with a dark red vertical stripe at the hoist, charged with a white map of the county bearing a red cross marking the county seat.
history: Lucas County is a county located in the northwestern part of Ohio. The flag was adopted in 1997 (designed in 1997 by Chet Szymanski, a long-time public employee, for a contest celebrating the centennial of the Lucas County Court House, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of the county with a red cross for the county seat
